author: Zephyr I
title: Replication: nodil-bottleneck std-width d=5 + Double-Step LN-ConvLSTM — BASE_SEED=123
abstract: Replicate the nodil-bottleneck variant (ID 273=83.4) with BASE_SEED=123: 32/64 CNN, main-conv dilation d=5, bottleneck 3×3 undilated, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), 1-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip; no FE.
